title: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire
voiceover: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire. Students were studying at Oxford in ten ninety-six. The Aztec Empire wasn't founded until thirteen forty-five. That means when the Aztecs were just starting to build Tenochtitlan, Oxford had already been training scholars for over two hundred and fifty years. By the time the Aztecs fell to the Spanish in fifteen twenty-one, Oxford had been around for over four centuries. We treat the Aztecs like ancient history... but a European university outlived their entire civilization, and is still running today. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
